NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: A planet $(P_1)$ is moving around the star of mass $2M$ in the orbit of radius $R$. Another planet $(P_2)$ is moving around another star of mass $4M$ in a orbit of radius $2R$. Ratio of time periods of revolution of $P_2$ and $P_1$ is ______.
stem.hi: एक ग्रह $(P_1)$ द्रव्यमान $2M$ वाले तारे के चारों ओर त्रिज्या $R$ की कक्षा में घूम रहा है। एक अन्य ग्रह $(P_2)$ द्रव्यमान $4M$ वाले दूसरे तारे के चारों ओर त्रिज्या $2R$ की कक्षा में घूम रहा है। $P_2$ और $P_1$ के परिक्रमण कालों का अनुपात ______ है।

feynman.en: For a circular orbit $T^2=\frac{4\pi^2r^3}{GM}$, so $T$ grows with $r^{3/2}$ and shrinks with $\sqrt M$.
feynman.hi: वृत्तीय कक्षा के लिए $T^2=\frac{4\pi^2r^3}{GM}$, अतः $T$, $r^{3/2}$ के साथ बढ़ता है और $\sqrt M$ के साथ घटता है।
